name: aws-mcp-setup
title_zh: MCP 连不上就喊它，文档检索和 API 权限一次配
tagline_zh: 不用翻 AWS 文档猜参数。它分两条路走：Full 版带凭证管 API，轻量版免登录只查文档。
tagline_en: Skip AWS doc spelunking. Two clear paths: full server with credentials for API, or auth-free docs-only mode.
desc_en: Configure AWS MCP servers for documentation search and API access. Use when setting up AWS MCP, configuring AWS documentation tools, troubleshooting MCP connectivity, or when user mentions aws-mcp, awsdocs, uvx setup, or MCP server configuration. Covers both Full AWS MCP Server (with uvx + credentials) and lightweight Documentation MCP (no auth required).
why_zh: 把 AWS MCP 的两种部署模式拆成清晰分支，按需选择。故障排查直接指向 uvx 或凭证层。
why_en: Splits AWS MCP into two explicit deployment branches so you pick the right one. Troubleshooting targets uvx or credential.
limit_zh: 只负责 AWS 官方 MCP 的配置与排错，不覆盖第三方 MCP 服务。
limit_en: Only configures/troubleshoots official AWS MCP servers, not third-party ones. Needs local uvx and AWS credentials (except docs-only mode). No IAM.
title_en: AWS MCP setup & troubleshooting: docs search and API.
